experiment_data.hypothesis: Evaluate 8B Cell C episode-level GRPO model (v9d step 10, val_before_train 96.875%) on 134 OOD ALFWorld tasks (valid_unseen). Step 10 is effective final model (reward saturated at step 12, zero gradients). This is the paper's key data point: 8B model OOD generalization under episode-level GRPO.
